- Option C: 2028-07-19 12:00 UTC (08:00 ET / 13:00 BST / 20:00 SGT) — friendly for EU, after US morning

Notes:
- We know Aurelius has a strong preference for APAC-local mornings for the CEO. Option B maps to 11:00 SGT on 19 Jul, which keeps things within their preferred window but is late for US execs.

If none of these work I can run a quick 1-click poll (Doodle/Calendly matrix) but preferred is that you flag availability on the three options so we can lock an exec slot now.
